question: Who among the following got defeated by Babur at Chanderi in 1528?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medini Rai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Medini Rai** was defeated by Babur at the Battle of Chanderi in 1528.
 
• The Battle of Chanderi was one of the significant battles fought by Babur after his victory at Panipat and Khanwa.
 
• Medini Rai was a Rajput chieftain and a prominent leader who opposed Babur's expansion in India.
 
• The defeat of Medini Rai consolidated Babur's control over the region, further strengthening his rule in northern India.
 
• This battle was part of Babur's efforts to suppress opposition and establish his dominance over the Rajput kingdoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Babur** was the founder of the Mughal Empire in India and is known for his military strategies and conquests.
 
• The Mughal Empire, established by Babur, lasted for several centuries and had a profound impact on the history and culture of India.
 
• Babur's memoirs, known as the **Baburnama**, provide detailed accounts of his battles, administration, and personal experiences.
 
• The victory at Chanderi was crucial for Babur as it helped in neutralizing the Rajput threat and securing his newly established empire.
 
• The Rajputs, known for their valor and martial traditions, were significant opponents to the Mughal expansion during Babur's reign.
